hero.name: Design Prototype Workshop
hero.tagline: Capture every stage of a craft design workshop on a phone or in the browser, hear every interview in English, and leave with the finished report, even where there is no signal.
hero.label: Design Prototype Workshop: capture every stage of a craft design workshop, hear every interview in English, and leave with the finished report

cards.label: What the portal does: capture, offline, reports, interviews, questionnaires, AI help, data, the Ministry and security

items.title: Every stage, one form
items.body: The stage set is declared once, as data, and drives the capture form, the completeness gate and the report.

items.title: No signal, no problem
items.body: The Android app records, queues and writes the finished report on the phone, then syncs when it can.

items.title: .docx and PDF
items.body: One document model renders prose, tables, maps and photographs to Word and PDF, on the server and on the phone.

items.title: Heard, then read in English
items.body: Scribe v2 writes speaker turns, Gemini 3.8 Flash translates them, and the viewer plays them word by word.

items.title: One engine, four clients
items.body: Forms, sessions, takes and answers share one engine and one parity registry across both portals.

items.title: Ask, draft, quote
items.body: Ask an interview, draft answers from it, make quote cards and grow a craft glossary, inside a monthly budget.

items.title: Browse and export
items.body: A data browser, Excel and CSV reports, streamed datasets and transcripts in every export.

items.title: Plans, orders, inspections
items.body: Sanction orders, the annual plan, inspections, ratings and the dashboard, on the web.

items.title: Who may do what
items.body: Eleven roles, two-factor sign-in, consent before any send and scoped grants on every route.

cards:ai.label: The AI suite: transcription, translation, Ask, drafts, quote cards, glossary, measurement and reading, on-device models, and the budget

items.title: Scribe v2
items.body: ElevenLabs speech-to-text with speaker turns, word timings and key terms from the craft. USD 0.22 an hour.

items.title: Gemini 3.8 Flash
items.body: One structured pass per transcript: English for every turn, a summary, quotes and craft terms.

items.title: Ask this interview
items.body: Answers come only from the transcript, with the moments they came from. Otherwise it says so.

items.title: Autodraft and refine
items.body: Draft questionnaire answers from a recording, or refine a transcript, and approve before anything is saved.

items.title: Measure and read
items.body: Grid measurement, photo captions and identity-card OCR, with on-device text recognition on Android.

items.title: Models on the phone
items.body: On-device dictation, sherpa-onnx speech and Gemma 4 on LiteRT, so help works with the radio off.
